scope: P1-A60 classic Xun You, Qice/Zhiyu rules and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网与BWIKI经典版本荀攸（魏3体力，奇策／智愚）

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结经典荀攸规则：奇策每个出牌阶段限一次，以至少一张且全部手牌视为任意普通锦囊；智愚在受到伤害后可摸一张、展示全部手牌，同色时令来源弃置一张手牌。该页同时提供574x761经典静态大图。
经典版本交叉核对魏势力、3体力、奇策／智愚，并明确与界限突破及国战版本分栏，防止混入界智愚的强制弃牌、获得弃牌与奇策次数增加，或国战奇策的目标数限制。
按用户指定概念页分类：奇策是出牌阶段由玩家操作的应用主动入口，使用ActionForms.Active；智愚需要玩家在伤害后确认是否发动，使用可选Trigger，不误标为Locked或State。展示按公开观看、牌仍留在原手牌区的语义处理。

ruleText.qice: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以将所有的手牌（至少一张）当做任意一张普通锦囊牌使用。
ruleText.zhiyu: 每当你受到伤害后，你可以摸一张牌，然后展示所有手牌，若颜色均相同，来源弃置一张手牌。

implementation.qiceInteraction: shared active-skill draft requires the exact complete hand, then a private choice freezes one legal ordinary-trick use with exact ordered targets and target card

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: the exact all-hand Qice cost, chosen ordinary-trick option, optional Zhiyu trigger and exact source discard reconstruct from the accepted command prefix
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: rules v108 keeps Qice and Zhiyu disabled even when package 1.87.0 is loaded; package 1.86.0 does not register Xun You

portrait.attribution: Official classic Xun You artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

assertions: Qice accepts exactly every current hand card and atomically rejects forged subsets
the second private Qice stage publishes only currently legal proactive ordinary-trick options with frozen exact target data
all Qice physical subcards enter Processing and are cleaned up through the existing trick, Jizhi, Nullification, response and damage paths
Qice is once per play phase and paused and completed command prefixes replay exactly
Zhiyu is optional after damage, draws once, publicly reveals the complete current hand without moving it, and makes a living source with cards privately choose one exact discard when all colors match
an AI source's private discard candidates do not leak into the human snapshot
rules v108 and package 1.86.0 preserve both pre-Xun-You boundaries
official portrait, structured skill types, active all-hand draft, private Qice/Zhiyu prompts and public battle cues render without clipping or binding errors

excludedVariants: boundary-breakthrough Zhiyu that always makes the source discard, may gain that card and may increase Qice uses
national-war Qice target-count cap and deputy-general change
self-battle and other-product Xun You definitions
Nullification as a proactive play-phase Qice option
deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
